newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Int'l Paper named best idea.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Int'l Paper named best idea.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities said it named International Paper Co as the "single best idea" in the paper group and set a 12-month price target of $60 a share.
-- Says more optimistic view on selected paper and forest product stocks is warranted as earnings are in early stage of an uptrend. Sees uptrend continuing throughout 1998.
-- Sees International Paper's product mix as well-positioned for coming "upcycle."
-- Remains concerned about lack of pricing uptrends in certain industry products. Foreign competition continues to remain a concern.
-- Shares up 7/8 at 41-3/4 in afternoon trade.
